t: Question Decomposition Engine - Signature build-tool concept
title: Question Decomposition Engine - Signature build-tool concept
definition: Splits complex questions into smaller retrieval questions.
description:
Every build an AI undertakes passes through Question Decomposition Engine: Splits complex questions into smaller retrieval questions. The catalog lists it among the thousand fundamental build tools because no serious building happens without it. This database is its Signature edition - the concept rebuilt as a deterministic framework with seven pillars, grounded in real techniques and standards, and taught through a ladder of runnable drills.

The Signature line treats Question Decomposition Engine as infrastructure, not inspiration. Infrastructure has contracts: given these inputs, in this state, the Question Decomposition Engine produces that output, and anyone can verify it. The seven pillars are those contracts made concrete - each owns one responsibility, each can be tested alone, and together they compose into the full capability. The technique records show the real public knowledge the pillars stand on.

Work through this database the way you would commission a machine: read the charter in the overview, inspect each pillar, check the techniques against your own knowledge, then run the drills. Every record includes a program you can execute with node - the Question Decomposition Engine is demonstrated, not merely described.

t: Signature Chunker - Question Decomposition Engine framework pillar
title: Signature Chunker - Question Decomposition Engine framework pillar
definition: The Chunker component of the Signature Question Decomposition Engine framework, owning chunker. Signature concept.
description:
The Signature Question Decomposition Engine framework decomposes the capability (Splits complex questions into smaller retrieval questions.) into seven pillars, and the Chunker is the one that owns the framework's chunker responsibilities. Owning a responsibility means three things in the Signature line: the pillar declares exactly what it accepts, it publishes exactly what it guarantees, and it logs enough evidence that a third party can replay its work and reach the same conclusion.

This discipline pays off when builds go wrong, because they always eventually do. When a Question Decomposition Engine result looks suspicious, the auditor does not re-run the whole build and hope; they replay the Chunker's log, check its guarantees against its inputs, and find the fault at its source. The pillar is thus both a worker and a witness - it does the work and it testifies about the work.

Try it yourself: this record's demo runs the Chunker's core procedure on a worked example. The program is plain JavaScript - save it as demo.js and run it with node, or press Run in the Demo Lab. Change the inputs and re-run; the procedure is deterministic, so you can verify every claim the description makes.

Signature framing: this pillar is part of the Signature line's original design for Question Decomposition Engine. It is labeled a Signature concept throughout - an engineered proposal, not an established public fact. The techniques it relies on are real and cited in the technique records of this database.

t: Signature Embedder - Question Decomposition Engine framework pillar
title: Signature Embedder - Question Decomposition Engine framework pillar
definition: The Embedder component of the Signature Question Decomposition Engine framework, owning embedder. Signature concept.
description:
The Embedder is a load-bearing component of the Signature Question Decomposition Engine framework. Its contract is narrow and absolute: within the framework, everything concerning the framework's embedder responsibilities belongs to the Embedder, and the Embedder answers for it. This separation is what makes the framework testable - the Embedder can be exercised alone, with declared inputs and checkable outputs, long before it is wired into a full build.

In operation the Embedder works like this. A build request arrives carrying the Question Decomposition Engine charter (splits complex questions into smaller retrieval questions.). The Embedder reads its portion of the charter, performs its transformation, and hands a verified intermediate result to the next pillar. If its checks fail, it stops the line and reports exactly what was wrong, instead of passing corruption downstream. That fail-fast discipline is the Signature line's signature.

Signature-concept illustration: a builder asks for a small rag job that needs Question Decomposition Engine. The Embedder takes the request's embedder responsibilities slice, applies the framework's deterministic procedure, and returns its result with a proof of what it did. Run this record's demo program to see the Embedder's core logic execute on a concrete example - the same logic, the same result, every run.

description:
